assessments.reasoning: The survey instrument measures hours worked solely in relation to paid work or main employment (Section 2, Part B, Q28, Q29, Q29a). It does not contain a time-use module or questions asking respondents how they allocate or spend time across daily activities such as unpaid domestic or care work. Unpaid care and household duties are only mentioned as response categories for inactivity, reasons for not seeking work, or reasons for not working more hours (Section 2, Part A, Q6 item 11, Q7 item 2; Section 2, Part H, Q60 item 6).
